name: Fractional Anisotropy (FA)
definition: A scalar measure of the degree of anisotropy in a voxel, derived from the eigenvalues of the diffusion tensor. It is rotationally invariant and prone to noise.
summary: Fractional Anisotropy is a rotationally invariant scalar metric that quantifies directional diffusion from tensor eigenvalues, distinguishing anisotropic structures from isotropic environments.
